flags.why: This ordinary adjective is used in everyday speech, so marking it literary misleadingly restricts its use.
Placing thuỷ chung directly before yêu in this sentence is unnatural Vietnamese.
flags.fix: Cô ấy yêu anh và luôn thuỷ chung với anh suốt đời. = She loved him and remained faithful to him all her life.

flags.why: The example explains a property of glass instead of showing the proposed scientific sense in use.
flags.fix: Các nhà nghiên cứu chế tạo một loại thuỷ tinh kim loại mới. = The researchers produced a new type of metallic glass.

flags.why: Thuỷ Tề refers to the mythical ruler of the waters, not his underwater realm, as illustrated in this [dictionary entry](https://phatgiao.org.vn/tu-dien-phat-hoc-online/thuy-cung-k5607.html).
flags.fix: water god; mythical king of the waters

flags.why: Xuống thuỷ tề incorrectly treats the name of the water god as a place.
flags.fix: Truyện kể rằng chàng xuống thuỷ cung gặp vua Thuỷ Tề. = The story says the young man went down to the underwater palace to meet the king of the waters.
